description: A DOI, arXiv id/URL or paper title -> the verified record plus BibTeX, RIS, APA 7, MLA 9, Chicago, IEEE, Harvard and Vancouver citations and in-text forms; for arXiv preprints also the peer-reviewed version if one exists. Needs a Quill Research Pass (1 USDC = 24 h, 5 USDC = 7 days, 15 USDC = 30 days by plain USDC transfer on Base; see payment_options), or pay per call over HTTP x402 ($0.01) at /v1/cite.

id.description: DOI (10.xxxx/...), doi.org URL, arXiv id (2005.11401) or arxiv.org URL, or a paper title. Omit for a demo.

pass.description: Optional Quill Research Pass token (qp1...). Better: set it once as the MCP header Authorization: Bearer <token>.
